premise.logline: A vineyard’s whole vintage turns in the barrel, and the cellar hand who topped it up has to work out what went in.

modules.theme: how a family decides which member is expendable
modules.setting_time: the winter after a hailstorm took half the crop
modules.setting_place: a hillside winery run by three siblings who share one cellar
modules.protagonist: a seasonal cellar hand who is not family
modules.protagonist_want: to keep her job by proving the spoilage was not her mistake
modules.antagonism: a sibling who would rather lose the vintage than the argument
modules.complication: the barrels were spoiled to force a sale she would have wanted
modules.ending_shape: the truth comes out, and nobody is better off for it
